index.html.summary: Identisure C# / .NET Client API client for the Identisure REST API. Documentation: identisure.github.io/api-client-csharp Requirements .NET 8 or later. Supported providers BankID SE: auth, sign, phone auth and sign, QR verify, age verification BankID NO: auth, backchannel auth, sign, age verification Freja eID: auth, backchannel auth, sign, backchannel sign, age verification MitID: auth, backchannel auth, sign, age verification FTN (Finnish Trust Network): auth, age verification Vipps MobilePay: auth, backchannel auth Documents: upload and download documents for signing Installation dotnet add package Identisure.Client Usage using Identisure.Client; using Identisure.Client.Models; var client = new IdentisureClientBuilder("client_id", "client_secret") .Environment(IdentisureEnvironment.Staging) .Build(); var session = await client.BankIdSe.AuthAsync(new BankIdSeAuthRequest()); if (session is BankIdSePending pending) { Console.WriteLine($"Session ID: {pending.Id}"); var result = await client.BankIdSe.WaitForAuthAsync(pending.Id); switch (result) { case BankIdSeCompleted done: Console.WriteLine($"Authenticated: {done.Name} ({done.Ssn})"); break; case BankIdSeFailed failed: Console.WriteLine($"Failed: {failed.Error}"); break; } } Verifying callbacks Verify the X-Signature-SHA256 header against the raw request body before parsing it: var valid = CallbackSignature.Verify(rawBody, signatureHeader, "hmac_secret"); Development Prerequisites .NET 8 SDK The tests use shared fixtures from a git submodule. Clone with --recurse-submodules, or run git submodule update --init in an existing clone. Build dotnet build Identisure.Client.sln Test dotnet test Identisure.Client.sln Release Set the version in src/Identisure.Client/Identisure.Client.csproj and src/Identisure.Client/Transport.cs and commit. Then push a tag: git tag v0.1.0 git push origin v0.1.0 The release workflow checks that the tag matches the version, runs CI, publishes to NuGet and creates a GitHub release.
